policyNote: Pin a tested version per dependency for stability. The sprint-start check (scripts/sj-deps-check.sh) NOTIFIES when an upstream has moved past the pin; it never auto-upgrades. Run `sj-deps-check.sh --update` to bump pins to the detected latest after you have tested them. metaswarm and the runtime backends are OPTIONAL — absence degrades gracefully per `absentBehavior`, it never blocks a sprint.

dependencies.purpose: Lane A async 'big pour' execution engine (spec -> pour -> formula -> harvest).
dependencies.absentBehavior: Lane A unavailable -> all work routes to Lane B (synchronous crew); gap logged.

dependencies.purpose: Optional adversarial-gate backend: cross-model review gates (plan/design), orchestrated IMPLEMENT->VALIDATE->REVIEW->COMMIT, and PR shepherd. When present (Claude Code runtime), SmokeJumper's gate phases may route through it; see SKILL.md Phases 3/5/6.
dependencies.absentBehavior: Use SmokeJumper's bundled adversarial review flow (the default). No functional loss; metaswarm only enriches the gate when installed under a Skill-tool-capable runtime.

dependencies.purpose: Optional deep adversarial bug-hunt (Hunter -> Skeptic -> Referee) run in REVIEW before push, complementary to the correctness/gate review. Finds runtime behavioral bugs across the change.
dependencies.absentBehavior: Skip the bugsweep pass; the adapter/bundled adversarial review gate is the review of record. No functional loss.

dependencies.purpose: Phase 8 HANDOFF — high-fidelity handoff prompt generation (Shane's handoff-prompt-skill, also distributed via the 'anthropic-skills' marketplace).

Product-context layer. EMBEDDED into SmokeJumper as references/product-context.md + templates/product-context.md so it works without the Skill tool (e.g. under a Codex orchestrator). Tracked here so the vendored copy can be re-synced from upstream.
dependencies.syncBehavior: When upstream moves past the vendored pin, re-sync the embedded copy (generalize + scrub), then bump the pin. The check NOTIFIES; it never overwrites the vendored copy automatically.

dependencies.purpose: Git-native issue tracker (`bd`) used for durable sprint state and as choo-choo-ralph's backing store.

source.note: Steve Yegge's Beads; record source.repo (e.g. owner/beads) when confirmed to enable auto version-check.

dependencies.absentBehavior: State lives in <target>/.smokejumper/ only; no bead IDs in the sprint log.

dependencies.purpose: Cross-model execution backend (Codex CLI) for large self-contained work and cross-model review.
dependencies.absentBehavior: Async/formula steps and reviews use Claude only; single-model review noted in the sprint summary.

dependencies.purpose: GitHub CLI — issue-tracker fallback when Beads is absent.
